name: use-click-outside
title: useClickOutside
description: Calls a function when a pointer goes down outside an element, to close menus and popovers.
a11y: No DOM output. Close popovers with Escape too; this hook covers pointer only.
Listens to pointerdown on the document and removes the listener on unmount.
